subject: Shiny server - Read multiple files and display combined results based multiple user selection

messages.author: 585eeec8f7b3b1e2
messages.subject: Shiny server - Read multiple files and display combined results based multiple user selection
parts:
I am trying to write a Shiny server app which reads in files from a directory in this format 

    /User/DE/AvsB.de.txt
    /User/DE/CvsD.de.txt
    /User/DE/EvsF.de.txt
    /User/DE/GvsH.de.txt

the file AvsB.de.txt looks like this, with each file containing same number of rows and columns - 

    Feature.ID Count.All Read.A Read.B L(A/B) p.Value F_value
    ENSG00000121898 3402.313005 6804.62601 0 0 .01 1.65E-62 9.88E-59
    ENSG00000229847 2161.412182 4322.824364 0 0 1.1 6.95E-54 1.54E-50
    ENSG00000104435 2151.95515 4303.9103 0 0 .02 7.79E-54 1.60E-50
    ENSG00000046889 1293.396669 2586.793339 0 0 1.3 1.60E-44 1.40E-41
    ENSG00000163288 859.4706557 0 1718.941311 Inf Inf 5.96E-42 4.18E-39

The server.R reads in the 4 files from the directory and populates the SelectInput with these 4 options. The user will be able to select upto 4 options  then display combined results from the text files based on these user selection. 
I am trying to get a table like this - 

    Feature.ID Read.Count.A Read.Count.B Read.Count.C Read.Count.D Read.Count.E Read.Count.F LFC(A/B) LFC(C/D) LFC(E/F)
    ENSG00000136235 45300.98106 8.446028978 45300.98106 1253.443358 -12.38898148 -10.52875097 -9.157069216
    ENSG00000168477 24388.90873 7.140759686 24388.90873 8319.556819 -11.73786002 -10.37241464 -9.089849566
    ENSG00000143196 2281.967618 0.690856066 2281.967618 3215.167435 -11.68960553 -10.36625877 -9.022552031

So far my code reads in the files from dir and shows selection options in box. 
But instead of showing the two filters and downloadable table, it gives me error **invalid 'path' argument**

        library(gtools)
    
    
    
    server <- function(input, output, session){
      D_files <- list.files(path = "/Users/DE/",pattern = "*.de_genes.txt" ,recursive = F, full.names = T)
      D_filename <- vector()
      for(i in 1:length(D_files)){
        D_filename[i] <- D_files[i]
      }

      D_filename <- unlist(strapplyc(D_filename, "/Users/DE/(.*).de_genes.txt"))
      
      names(D_files)<- D_filename
      
      output$Quad_plot_comparison <- renderUI({
        selectizeInput(inputId = "Quad_comparison",label = h3("Select comparison"), choices = mixedsort(D_files), multiple = TRUE)
      })
      
      DExpTable_data <- reactive({
        
        input$select_comprison_option
        
        geneData <- read.table(file = list.files(path = input$select_comparison_option,pattern = "*.de_genes.txt" ,recursive = F, full.names = T), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
        row.names(geneData) <- geneData[,1]
        
        
        geneMatrix <- geneData[,2:6]
        geneMatrix <- apply(geneMatrix,2, function(i) {round(i,digits = 2)})
        geneMatrix[,4] <- infinity_eliminator(geneMatrix[,4])
        geneMatrix[,5] <- infinity_eliminator(geneMatrix[,5])
        geneData <- data.frame(geneData[,1], geneMatrix, geneData[,7:8])
        names(geneData)[1] <- "Gene_ID"
        geneData
      })

      output_DExpTable_data <- reactive({
    sDExpTable_data()
      })
  
      output$DExp <- DT::renderDataTable({

        DT::datatable(output_DExpTable_data(), extensions = c('ColReorder'), rownames = FALSE, options = list(scrollX = T, dom = 'rltip', colReorder = TRUE,fixedHeader = TRUE),escape = F)
      })
      
      output$downloadTable_DExp<- downloadHandler(
        filename = function() {
          paste("DExp", '.csv', sep='')
        },
        content = function(file) {
          write.csv(output_DExpTable_data(), file)
        }
      )
      
    }

    ui <- fluidPage ( 
      headerPanel("Data explorer"),
      sidebarPanel("Data",
                   
                   HTML("<br><br>")  
      ),
      
      mainPanel(
        
        uiOutput("Quad_plot_comparison"),
        HTML("<br><br>"), 
        
       
        fluidRow(
          DT::dataTableOutput("DExp"), width = "100%", height = "100%"),
        fluidRow(column(6,downloadButton('downloadTable_DExp', 'Download Table')))
        
      )
    )
    shinyApp(ui = ui , server = server)
